entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), same as lowerVectorSetOp's identical check for the float case

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram set-op operand lowering published %s row shape (%T), want %s
entries.rationale: internal invariant: both callers only reach lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand after isExpHistogramValuedShape already confirmed the operand histogram-valued — lowerExpHistogramSetOp unconditionally (its own recogniser, expHistogramSetOp, requires it of BOTH operands), lowerVectorSetOpOperand behind its own identical guard (cerberus issue #2325) — so this histogram-valued lowering can never publish a non-HistogramRowShape node here

entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: exp-histogram set-op operand matched no known histogram-valued shape for %v
entries.rationale: internal invariant: both callers only reach lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand after isExpHistogramValuedShape already confirmed the operand matches a known histogram-valued shape — lowerExpHistogramSetOp unconditionally, lowerVectorSetOpOperand behind its own identical guard (cerberus issue #2325) — so lowerExpHistogramSetOpOperand's own re-dispatch through lowerExpHistogramValuedShape can never report unmatched here
